content: कल्किः The tenth and last incarnation of Viṣṇu in his capacity of the destroyer of the wicked and liberator of the world from its enemies; (Jayadeva, while referring to the several {%avatāras%} of Viṣṇu, thus refers to the last or {%Kalki%} avatāra:-- म्लेच्छनिवहनिधने कलयसि करवालं धूमकेतुमिव किमपि करालम् . केशवधृतकल्किशरीरं जय जगदीश हरे .. <ls>Gīt. 1. 10.</ls>) .{@-पुराणम्@} <ab>N.</ab> of a Purāṇa.
